Thanks for the context. I sketched a conservative Dedicated fleet layout and a fast-path option for the low-latency endpoints. Notes below — this is a pre-sales estimate, not a commitment.

Assumptions pulled from sample:
- 420 concurrent active requests at peak (assume steady state during 10-minute windows)
- Average token output per request: 500 tokens
- p95 token length: 1100 tokens
- 65% of requests are generation-style (higher compute), 35% are cheaper

Sizing sketch (mix of A100-80GB equivalent / Hopper variants):
- Baseline fleet for throughput: 4 x A100-80GB (in Dedicated pool) serving batching-optimized generation; expected sustained concurrency per GPU ~120 (with batching and KV cache) => ~480 effective concurrency headroom
- Low-latency fast-path: 2 x T4-like low-latency instances (or quantized Llama family on T4 equivalents) reserved for interactive chat endpoints. These serve sub-350ms tail with lighter batches and lower sequence lengths.
- Reserve buffer: +20% capacity for burst/rollouts => recommend contract for 6 instances total (4 heavy + 2 fast-path) as initial commit, allow burst to 8 during onboarding.

Estimated token throughput and cost drivers:
- Average token/sec per heavy GPU (observed with batching): ~180–240 tokens/sec depending on model; for avg 500 tokens/request this maps to ~0.36–0.48 requests/sec per heavy GPU under expected batch efficiency.
- p95 long requests will occupy KV/attention longer; plan to offload via policy-based routing to allow long-run tasks to time-slice without hurting interactive SLAs.

Questions / clarifications needed from Novasys:
- Do you expect long-running streaming sessions (chat with many turns) vs single-request generation?
- Are embeddings and async classification batched on your side, or do they come as real-time single calls?
- Which endpoints must have the strictest SLA? (we can put them on the fast-path pool)

Next steps I recommend:
- Review the attached fleet-sizing-template.xlsx (I filled preliminary numbers in the "instance mapping" tab)
- 30-minute sizing review with Novasys, me, and Ben to align burst policy and fallback (can do Monday morning PT)

If that looks reasonable I can convert to a pricing config and a Dedicated capacity proposal draft.

— Dev
